phase_1.arguments: temp at rsp, base H+0x1748, tag 1, candidate field at node+0x28
phase_1.note: call-shape only; tag 1 equals the candidate kind gate

phase_2.arguments: temp at rsp, base H+0x1748, tag 2, candidate field at node+0x28
phase_2.note: call-shape only; tag 2 equals the candidate kind gate; a different builder from phases A and 1

phase_a.arguments: temp at rsp, base H+0x1748, tag 0, candidate field at node+0x28
phase_a.note: call-shape only; tag 0 equals the candidate kind gate

copy_path.bytes_unwritten: out bytes +0x06..+0x07 are written by no path in this routine
copy_path.fields: out dword = temp dword; out word +0x04 = temp word +0x04; out qword +0x08 = temp qword +0x08
copy_path.note: the temp heap pointer moves into out; no delete call on the phase-2 path

fail_path.trigger: null head, walk ending at the sentinel, or candidate kind above the phase gate

flags.flag0: dword at H+0x5d0; nonzero runs phase A, zero skips it
flags.flag1: dword at H+0x5d4, re-read after a successful phase A; nonzero runs phase 1, zero skips it

layout.head: qword at H+0x1790
layout.node_fields: kind byte at node+0x20, next pointer at node+0x10, alternate pointer at node+0x18, builder field at node+0x28
layout.out: rdi, returned unchanged in every success path
layout.temp: 16-byte record at rsp: dword +0x00, word +0x04, qword +0x08

phase_1.gate: candidate kind must be at most 1; the walk only records kind-nonzero nodes, so exactly 1
phase_1.success: temp flag byte 0: delete temp qword +0x08 when non-null, reload head, run phase 2
phase_1.walk: from head: kind-0 nodes step via +0x18, kind-nonzero nodes become the candidate and descend via +0x10; ends when the next pointer is null

phase_2.gate: candidate kind must be at most 2; the walk only records kind-above-1 nodes, so exactly 2
phase_2.success: copy temp into out and return out
phase_2.walk: from head: kind-at-most-1 nodes step via +0x18, kind-above-1 nodes become the candidate and descend via +0x10; ends when the next pointer is null

phase_a.success: temp flag byte 0: delete temp qword +0x08 when non-null, reload head, continue at the flag1 test
phase_a.walk: follow +0x10 links from head to the last non-null node

routine.arguments: rdi = out record pointer; rsi = holder pointer H; returns out

unknowns: What the builders 0x5f22020 and 0x5f22f80 compute inside the temp record
What the assign helper 0x5d49b10 computes from the temp record
The source-level meaning of the holder, the node kinds and the tag values
How a phase 1 or phase 2 walk behaves if it steps onto the sentinel node itself; the model stops the walk there
Caller guarantees on graph shape; the walks carry no visited set, so a cyclic graph loops forever in the binary as in the model

zero_path.assign: 0x5d49b10(out, temp) with out zeroed first, call-shape only
zero_path.delete: delete of temp qword +0x08 when non-null, after the assign call
zero_path.fields: out dword = 0, out word +0x04 = 0, out qword +0x08 = 0
zero_path.reached_from: phase A or phase 1 when the builder temp flag byte is nonzero
